params.name: token
params.description: Authorization token obtained from the /login endpoint.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query string. Supports field-specific searches using the format field:value (e.g., headline:election, body:markets). Multiple terms can be combined.

params.name: channel
params.description: Optional channel alias to restrict search results to a specific channel.

params.name: dateRange
params.description: Filter results by date range. Specify a date range to restrict results to items published within that period.

params.name: mediaType
params.description: Filter results by media type to restrict to specific content formats.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return in the response.

items.docs: Searches for content items matching specified criteria across one or more channels. Supports keyword queries against item headlines and content, with optional filtering by channel, date range, and media type. The search query syntax supports field-specific searches using the format field:value (e.g., headline:election).
